description: Sets the final selection set of a native or custom select-like control to the requested choices. Automatically handles searchable controls, virtual scrolling, and pagination associated with the control. Each selection item must use exactly one locator: id, value, label, or path.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the select-like control.

id.description: Preferred canonical control ID from DOM.getAXTree or DOM.inspectSelect.

selector.description: CSS selector for a select-like control. It must resolve to one control; use DOM.inspectSelect or DOM.getAXTree when the target contains multiple controls.

id.description: Opaque canonical option ID returned by DOM.inspectSelect or DOM.getAXTree. Use id only when this is the only locator field in the item.

value.description: One direct option locator. Use the exact value returned by DOM.inspectSelect, and do not combine it with id or label.

label.description: One direct option locator. Use the exact visible label returned by DOM.inspectSelect, and do not combine it with id or value.

path.description: Exclusive cascading locator. Do not provide id, value, or label alongside path; each path segment must contain exactly one of id, value, or label.

id.description: Opaque canonical option ID returned by DOM.inspectSelect or DOM.getAXTree. Use id only when this is the only locator field in the item.

value.description: One possible option locator. Use the exact value returned by DOM.inspectSelect, and do not combine it with id or label.

label.description: One possible option locator. Use the exact visible label returned by DOM.inspectSelect, and do not combine it with id or value.

selections.description: Each item must contain exactly one locator: id, value, label, or path. path is exclusive and each path segment must contain exactly one of id, value, or label. Multiple direct choices define the final multi-select set, not an append operation, and are valid only for a confirmed multi-select control.

timeout.description: Maximum exploration time in seconds. Omit or pass 0 to use the 300-second default.

purpose.description: Describe the intended selected values, such as choosing a country, date, color, tags, or a root-to-leaf cascading location path. Each selections item must contain exactly one of id, value, label, or path; path is exclusive and each path segment must contain exactly one of id, value, or label. Use exact fields returned by DOM.inspectSelect. Multiple direct choices require a multi-select control; multiple cascading paths are unsupported. Use DOM.inspectSelect when choices are unknown or when target resolution is ambiguous or fails.
